name: Anthony G. Forlini
summary: Anthony G. Forlini (born February 4, 1962) is an American businessman and politician serving as the county clerk of Macomb County, Michigan since 2021. A member of the Republican Party, Forlini previously served as a member of the Michigan House of Representatives from 2011 through 2016, and as the supervisor of Harrison Township, Michigan from 2004 to 2011. He was the Republican nominee for the 2026 Michigan Secretary of State election, losing to democratic nominee Garlin Gilchrist.
